title: Everything Around It
text: Describe the things, places, or context around the answer instead of describing the answer itself.

title: What It's Not
text: Give clues only by saying what the answer isn't.

title: Senses
text: Describe the answer using only sight, sound, smell, taste, or touch.

title: You
text: You are the answer. Give clues about yourself from the answer's point of view.

title: Adjective + Noun + Verb
text: Each clue must be exactly three words: adjective + noun + verb.

title: Three Words
text: Each clue must be exactly three words.

title: Questions Only
text: Every clue must be phrased as a question.

title: One-Syllable Words
text: Use only one-syllable words. If the table isn't sure about a word, decide quickly and keep moving.

title: Adjectives & Nouns Only
text: Use only adjectives and nouns in your clues.

title: Verbs & Nouns Only
text: Use only verbs and nouns in your clues.

title: Comparisons
text: Describe properties of the answer only by comparing them to something else, such as size, weight, texture, brightness, speed, or another quality.

title: Two Pieces
text: Each clue must have exactly two parts separated by a brief pause.

title: Checklist Inspection
text: Give each clue like an inspection checklist: say a feature, then say "check."

title: It's Like, But Not That
text: Every clue must use the format: "It's like ___, but not that."

title: Trade-Offs Only
text: Every clue must use the format: "Great for ___, terrible for ___."

title: Safety Warnings
text: Every clue must sound like a warning label or safety instruction.

title: No Physical Description
text: Do not describe what the answer looks like, including its shape, size, color, or physical features.

title: No Function
text: Do not describe what the answer does or what people use it for.

title: Appearance Only
text: Describe only what the answer looks like, including its shape, size, color, or physical features.

title: Function Only
text: Describe only what the answer does or what people use it for.

title: Can / Can't
text: Every clue must use the format: "It can ___, but it can't ___."

title: You Find It...
text: Every clue must use the format: "You find it [at/in/with] ___."

title: You Can ___ It
text: Every clue must use the format: "You can ___ it."

title: It Has ___
text: Every clue must use the format: "It has ___."

title: Best At / Worst At
text: Alternate clues in order: "Best at..." then "Worst at..." and repeat.

title: Most Likely / Least Likely
text: Alternate clues in order: "Most likely to..." then "Least likely to..." and repeat.

title: Two Words
text: Each clue must be exactly two words.

title: Build a Clue
text: Start with a one-word clue. Your next clue must be exactly two words, then three, then four, and so on.

title: Ingredients / Nutrition Label
text: Describe what the answer is made of as if you're reading an ingredients list or nutrition label. Literal and made-up ingredients are both allowed.

title: Motto / Slogan
text: Give every clue as a motto, slogan, or tagline for the answer.

title: Clickbait Headline
text: Give every clue as a ridiculous clickbait headline about the answer.

title: Good News / Bad News
text: Alternate clues in order: "Good news..." then "Bad news..." and repeat.

title: Quick Start Guide
text: Describe how to use or interact with the answer as numbered quick-start instructions.
